svg.title: Selective angular error by uncertainty score

cc:Work.dc:title: Selective angular error by uncertainty score
cc:Work.dc:description: Fig. S4. Selective angular error in 242 internal-validation images. (A, B) Alpha/beta MAE after retaining lower scores from total, dropout-only, or conditional-only angular SD, or average landmark spread. Each curve contains every retained count from 121 to 242. Expected random retention equals the all-image MAE, rather than one random subsample. The unavailable oracle ranks observed errors. Whiskers on Total and Landmark spread show 95% image-bootstrap CIs from 10,000 reranked resamples at 121, 194, and 242 images (50.0%, 80.2%, and 100%). All methods use identical predictions and reference errors. Coincident full-retention estimates represent the same images.
